messages:
maya: FYI prod-eu canaries started failing after a large cache eviction event. Suggest holding all releases in the queue until we confirm stability. DeployBot shows 7/10 canaries failing on model-serving. @jules_ops can you confirm?

DeployBot: deploybot: Canary run id 2026-05-12T14:02Z -> failures on service model-serving-prod-eu (503) x7. Recent error snippet: see /deploy/logs/2026/1789456123.
```
  ERROR grpc: recv failed: connection reset by peer
  503 GET /v1/generate  - downstream: model-serving-prod-eu - kvcache miss flood
```

jules_ops: Confirmed. Eviction caused a cascade of backend gRPC errors and connection resets. We're seeing a spike in 5xx; SLO alert fired. Putting immediate hold on all release slots for prod-eu. @neha please pause any scheduled canaries and stop pending deploys to that region.

neha: Paused scheduled canaries and removed queued slots from the deploybot pool. Which releases are affected exactly?

maya: Recent canary for orbit-release v2.4.1 failed, and queued slots 14/15/16 are blocked. Recommend pinning orbit-release back to v2.4.0 for now and consider a targeted rollback if canaries don't recover within 30m.

samir: +1 on pin. Prefer targeted canary rollback for affected shards rather than org-wide rollback. If we pin, update the deploy manifest to lock image to orbit:v2.4.0. Example:
```
# deploy.yaml
image: ghcr.io/redwood/orbit:v2.4.0
```
Also will prepare rollback playbook.

ryan: Ops are reproducing locally with the cache-stress tool. Looks like eviction + yesterday's ksm tweak is causing memory churn -> GRPC resets. Suggest reverting the ksm tweak in prod-eu first and monitoring.

jules_ops: Rolling back the ksm tweak in eu-west-1a now (controlled zone revert). If that stabilizes, we'll do a staged revert across remaining zones.

sentinel-bot: sentinel-bot: Observed 5xx rate dropping from 7.2% -> 1.1% in eu-west-1a after revert. Recommend phased requeue: start 10% of queued releases -> monitor 15m -> if healthy 50% -> monitor 30m -> then full.

maya: That plan sounds good. Proposed timeline: phased requeue starting 17:40 UTC, staged percentages as suggested by sentinel-bot. Notify PMs and update release notes to mention the transient canary failures and the temporary pin. @samir can you coordinate the manifest push and rollback actions?

samir: On it. Will push pinned manifests to the deploy branch, add a short rollback playbook link in the PR, and kick canaries 1/3 at a time once ops gives the green light.

neha: Updated deploy queue and calendar: orbit:v2.4.1 pinned to v2.4.0, release window shifted to 17:40-20:00 UTC. Added note to release calendar and pinged the PMs.

maya: Thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread for updates during the requeue. If phased canaries pass we'll lift the hold; if not, we escalate to full rollback schedule. :thumbsup:
